errors.text: The proposed CoCrFeMnNi or refractory composition does not reconstruct the AuCoCuNiPt system, whose Au and Cu surface energies and volatility are central to the target mechanism.

The predicted phase decomposition and grain growth above 50 nm differ from the observed Au/Cu surface segregation, melting and evaporation, loss of 2–4 nm particles, and approximately 22% particle-size reduction.

The extended 1–100 hour annealing protocol does not reproduce the stepped in situ ramp to 973 K and cannot distinguish intrinsic heating behavior from long-time coarsening, sintering, or support-mediated effects.
The cited evidence does not directly establish accelerated diffusion or thermal instability in sub-10 nm five-component nanoparticles.
